Plot FPCR wild-bootstrap truncation scan with an optional selected component

etr_plot_fpca_wild_bootstrap_truncation_scan.Rd

Read-only display of precomputed studentized wild-bootstrap interval width or center over candidate inference truncations. Explicit source mode reproduces Python zero-based target indexing without altering the native one-based default.

Usage

etr_plot_fpca_wild_bootstrap_truncation_scan(
  result, target = 1L, metric = "width", strict_source_record = FALSE
)

Arguments

result

Already computed wild-bootstrap truncation scan record, or selection record with embedded scan.

target

Exact target ID or numeric target index. Legacy R default is 1-based; when strict_source_record = TRUE, numeric indices are zero-based, with omitted target interpreted as zero.

metric

Either "width" or "center".

strict_source_record

If TRUE, return a native typed record of the frozen Python 1.2 scientific Matplotlib line and optional selected-h reference. Default FALSE keeps the original R plot and source numerical return.

Value

Invisibly original numerical scan line, selected inference component, target ID and provenance by default. In strict mode a typed etr_predictive_scientific_artist_record with candidate-h values, metric line, optional vertical selected-h reference, source title, labels and conditional legend. No Python Axes is returned.

Details

Strict scientific geometry does not imply that automatic truncation selection, full Python typed-object validation, Python error classes, Matplotlib runtime identity or independent scientific certification are reproduced.
